title: Uniform Decoder
text: Decode integer input into floating-point output, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Peak} sets the largest amplitude in encoded input, {Bits} sets the number of bits, {Overflow mode} and {Output type} sets the output data type. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Peak
params.values: Largest amplitude in encoded input 1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Bits
params.values: Number of bits 3 (default) | integer in the range [ 2, 32 ]
